update.name: Joomla Profile Slim Display
update.description: Standalone Joomla module: displays the logged-in user's display name and avatar in the top header navbar using Joomla's built-in profile system. Optional Community Builder awareness — when CB is installed the profile link follows CB's canonical View Profile menu item. Transition update that renames the installed module element to mod_profileslim.
update.author: Jayden Russell
